item.title: [Workshop] NUS AI and Robotics Workshop
item.description: This workshop is intended for current Sec 4 and JC1 students. Current Sec 3 and JC2 students will be place on reserved list. Those who are free on 4th and 7th Dec may want to sign up for the NUS AI and Robotics Workshop. Fee of charge. Lunch and tea break provided. NUS is offering 10 places for HCI. So far we already have 3 sign-ups. Contact me at limjn@hci.edu.sg if you have any questions. Registration Link: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScQftFH-0v71gaYd9tzYBSU6Ei7JjJM-QhiqggzVaqi86ZhDg/viewform?usp=publish-editor NUS AI and Robotics Workshop Limited to first 10 Sec 4 and JC1 students who apply. Current Sec 3 and JC2 students will be placed on the reserved list. Date: 4th and 7th December 2026 Time: 0900h to 1700h Venue: NUS, E4-04-05 Fee: Free of charge Be the Smart Robot Builder of Tomorrow. Proudly organised by the Department of Electrical & Computer Engineering (ECE), NUS. Ever Wondered How Self-Driving Cars "See" the Road? Your phone unlocks with your face. Delivery and cleaning robots move autonomously across campus. Cars are learning to drive themselves. Behind all these innovations lies a powerful capability: teaching machines to see, understand, and make decisions. Want to learn how it works? In this hands-on workshop, you'll go beyond being a user and become the builder: Teach a robot to read the world — train a YOLOv26 AI model to recognise traffic signs and scan QR codes, just like the self-checkout at your favourite store, but smarter. Give your robot a sense of space — use LIDAR, IMU and UWB sensors (the same tech in cutting-edge gadgets) to help it navigate like a tiny self-driving car. Bring your robot to life with code — write Python programs that transform sensor data and AI predictions into real-world actions. When the robot sees something, it responds and moves accordingly. By the end of the workshop, you'll: Understand how object-detection AI models are trained and deployed. Learn how QR-code detection and recognition work. Discover how robots determine direction and position. Gain hands-on experience programming autonomous robotic systems with Python. No prior experience is required. All you need is curiosity, enthusiasm, and a willingness to experiment. If you encounter challenges along the way, don't worry. You'll be supported by your instructors and fellow builders throughout the workshop. Workshop Information The workshop is completely free of charge. Lunch and light refreshments will be provided. Selected participants will have the opportunity to experience life at NUS ECE over two exciting days of hands-on learning. Up to ten students from each school will be selected. Additional applicants may be placed on a waiting list and offered places if vacancies arise. Preference will be given to Secondary 4 and JC1 students . No prior programming or robotics experience is required, although students with some coding experience may be able to progress slightly faster. As places are limited, please register only if you can commit to attending both workshop days in full . More workshop details can be found here. Registration Link: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScQftFH-0v71gaYd9tzYBSU6Ei7JjJM-QhiqggzVaqi86ZhDg/viewform?usp=publish-editor
